review.notes: Full normalized-text comparison of all 17 physical PDF pages against the OCR Markdown. All body prose, the abstract, all eight figure captions, all three tables (including the print's own 'Ture' misspellings in Table 3), the 82 reference entries and the demo-prompt caption blocks under Figures 4, 6, 7 and 8 are present and match the print; the four restored patches are print-faithful restorations of the paper's own misspellings ('chanlleging', 'aviod' twice) and one OCR name misread in reference [71]. Figure-internal panel labels (Figure 1-3, 5 diagram text, comparison-grid model names around Figures 7-8) stay embedded in the figure images; the OCR's uppercase styling of the printed 'TASK-Outpainting'-style sub-labels was left unchanged as caption styling. No code fences exist in the source.
